headline: India Flash November PMI Shows Manufacturing Demand Offsetting Slower Services Growth
summary: India's flash purchasing managers' index indicated sustained expansion in private sector activity during November. Robust manufacturing demand compensated for a minor deceleration in services sector growth.
why: India's PMI survey tracks business activity across key industrial and service sectors in the world's fifth-largest economy.

impacts.name: India
impacts.why: Sustained manufacturing strength supports underlying economic growth.
